## Description

Provide a brief description of the changes introduced by this pull request, including what problem it solves and how.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (typos, clarifications, or missing guides)
- [ ] Code polish or refactoring (no functional changes)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the Kotlin and Jetpack Compose coding guidelines defined in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I have verified my changes on a real device or emulator.
- [ ] I have run the unit test suite (`./gradlew :app:test`) and all tests pass.
- [ ] (If applicable) I have updated the documentation (`README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`) to reflect these changes.
- [ ] (If touching the USSD pipeline) I have completed the manual USSD testing checklist on a real SIM.
